NEDERLANDS 
Bij Kurkumama koken we Perzisch eten zoals we het zelf graag eten. Onze khoresh heeft tijd nodig, dus je begint eraan lang voor de eerste bestelling. En als iemand het voor het eerst proeft, nemen we even de tijd om uit te leggen wat er in de pot zit.
 

We zoeken een kok die graag zelf aan het fornuis staat. Je zet de mise-en-place klaar, kookt en werkt de gerechten af. Als het druk wordt, hou je samen met de collega’s aan de counter het overzicht. Je proeft, stuurt bij waar nodig en laat je werkplek klaar achter voor de volgende shift.
 

Heb je nog nooit Perzisch gekookt? Dan leren we je graag onze gerechten kennen. Je kan voltijds of deeltijds aan de slag bij Kurkumama, Waterpoort 2 in Kortrijk, met een contract van bepaalde of onbepaalde duur. Vertel ons gerust wat jij graag kookt: https://kurkumama.fillout.com/jobs of jobs@kurkumamagroup.com.
 

ENGLISH 
At Kurkumama, we cook Persian food the way we like to eat it. Our khoresh takes time, so you start it well before the first order comes in. And when someone tries it for the first time, we take a moment to tell them what’s in the pot.
 

We’re looking for a cook who likes being at the stove. You’ll prep, cook and finish dishes. When it gets busy, you’ll work with the team at the counter to keep service moving. You’ll taste as you go, adjust when something needs it and leave the station ready for the next shift.
 

If you haven’t cooked Persian food before, we’ll teach you our dishes. Full-time or part-time at Kurkumama, Waterpoort 2, Kortrijk. A fixed-term or open-ended contract is possible. Tell us what you love to cook: https://kurkumama.fillout.com/jobs or jobs@kurkumamagroup.com.

NEDERLANDS 
Een nieuw gerecht bedenken is één ding. Ervoor zorgen dat het ook tijdens een drukke service even goed smaakt, vraagt iemand die naast het team in de keuken staat. Daarvoor zoeken we een Executive Chef.
 

Je ontwikkelt en test recepten, begeleidt onze keukenleads en helpt de centrale productie slimmer organiseren. Je kijkt naar smaak, porties, kostprijs en verspilling. Als een recept op papier klopt maar tijdens de service niet werkt, ga je met het team aan de slag tot het wel werkt. Je werkt vanuit Kortrijk met de keukenteams van Kurkumama Group. Voltijds of deeltijds, met een contract van bepaalde of onbepaalde duur.
 

Vertel ons over een gerecht of een keuken die jij beter hebt gemaakt. Solliciteer via https://kurkumama.fillout.com/jobs of jobs@kurkumamagroup.com.
 

ENGLISH 
Coming up with a new dish is one thing. Making sure it tastes just as good in the middle of a busy service takes someone who’ll get in the kitchen with the team. That’s the Executive Chef we’re looking for.
 

You’ll develop and test recipes, coach our kitchen leads and improve how we work in the central kitchen. You’ll pay attention to flavour, portions, cost and waste. When a recipe works on paper but falls apart in service, you’ll work through it with the team. You’ll be based in Kortrijk and work with kitchen teams across Kurkumama Group. Full-time or part-time. A fixed-term or open-ended contract is possible.
 

Tell us about a dish or a kitchen you’ve helped make better. Apply at https://kurkumama.fillout.com/jobs or jobs@kurkumamagroup.com.

What if you could build the systems that allow industrial machines to understand where they are, decide where to go, and navigate safely through the real world?At M-ECS, you’ll help shape the next generation of autonomous off-highway vehicles and mobile robotic platforms. You'll work at the intersection of robotics, navigation and intelligent vehicle systems, developing the technology that enables machines to understand their position, plan their movements and navigate safely through complex environments. You’ll have the opportunity to help shape the autonomy stack from the ground up, from SLAM and localization to planning, decision-making and real-world deployment.You’ll see your work move from 
algorithm → machine → real-world impact.
 

 
 

YOUR ROLE, YOUR IMPACT. As a Autonomous Navigation & SLAM Engineer, you’ll take ownership of the navigation and autonomy capabilities that enable mobile machines to operate safely and intelligently in complex, dynamic environments.
 

Key responsibilities: 
 
 

• Autonomy & Navigation: Developing navigation capabilities, including SLAM, localization, pose estimation and 2D/3D mapping. 

• Path Planning: Implementing global and local path planning, cost maps and collision-free trajectory generation for safe and efficient autonomous operation. 

• Behavioral Planning & Decision-Making: Developing intelligent real-time behaviors, including obstacle detection, prediction and avoidance, for actions such as driving, stopping, following and overtaking. 

• Sensor Fusion: Integrating data from cameras, LiDAR, radar, IMU and GNSS to improve localization, environmental awareness, and navigation. 

• Obstacle Detection & Avoidance: Developing capabilities to detect, predict and avoid obstacles in dynamic environments. 

• Real-Time Optimization: Improving navigation and planning algorithms for efficient real-time execution on embedded and GPU-based platforms. 

• System Integration & Validation: Integrating, testing, debugging and validating autonomous navigation systems together with other engineers, both in simulation and on real machines in the field. 

ARE YOU THE ONE?You're a 
hands-on engineer with a genuine 
passion for 
robotics, autonomous navigation and SLAM. You're fascinated by how machines understand their position, map their surroundings and navigate complex environments. You enjoy 
tackling technical challenges, developing algorithms and 
turning ideas into working solutions. You don't stop at simulation or the drawing board. You love programming, testing, debugging and seeing your work come to life on real machines. You're 
curious, 
analytical and 
eager to explore new technologies. You take 
initiative, think beyond the obvious and enjoy experimenting, solving problems and building intelligent systems alongside your team.
 
 

• A 
Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Automation, AI, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

• A background/experience in (mobile) robotics, autonomous vehicles or industrial automation. 

• Experience with or 
technical knowledge of: 
 

• Autonomous navigation, 
SLAM, localization and state estimation, mapping, including LiDAR/visual SLAM, EKF or factor-graph approaches. 

• Path planning and trajectory optimization, e.g. A*, D* or RRT/RRT* 

• Programming in C++ and Python 

• Robotics frameworks such as ROS/ROS2 

• 3D Geometry, coordinate transformations, kinematics, sensor fusion, and real-time system constraints.   

• Experience with off-highway machinery, autonomous vehicles or AGVs, behavior trees, OMPL/MPC, GPU acceleration, simulation tools such as Gazebo, CARLA or Isaac Sim, NVIDIA Jetson or safety-critical systems is a plus. Experience testing or deploying robotic systems on real machines in the field is also a plus! 

• Strong communication skills in 
English and 
Dutch.

• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.

jobs.description:
As a Freight Forwarder Export Air, you will be responsible for managing your own shipments and coordinating the entire transport process from A to Z.

Your responsibilities

Manage daily customer service and maintain close contact with clients regarding air export shipments.

Create and manage shipments in the company's own TMS system.

Provide clear instructions to the customs team to ensure the correct preparation of customs documentation.

Communicate daily with the international network regarding shipment pre-alerts and quotations.

Ensure accurate invoicing and maintain high-quality data management.

Apply and respect all company compliance standards, including security regulations, embargoed countries, carriers and restricted goods.

About our client

Our client is a leading international player in the transport and logistics sector, with a strong global network and expertise in air, sea, road and rail freight.

The company is committed to providing reliable, efficient and high-quality logistics solutions, ensuring that supply chains run smoothly worldwide.

With a strong focus on operational excellence, innovation and continuous improvement, our client encourages employees to take initiative, develop their skills and contribute to the company's ongoing growth.

You will join an international and dynamic environment where teamwork, customer satisfaction and professional development are key priorities.

First experience in Freight Forwarding, preferably in Air Freight.

Good command of Dutch or French and English.

Able to quickly learn and work with new IT systems.

Available to work a fixed late shift from 14:00 to 22:12.

All these requirements are important for this Freight Forwarder vacancy in Machelen.

Above all, our client is looking for someone who feels comfortable in a dynamic and international working environment, enjoys taking initiative, is eager to learn and is motivated to grow professionally.

If you are someone who likes to take on challenges, shows initiative and wants to develop your career in logistics, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

What will you do?

• Weld and bond plastic and PVC components.
• Assemble custom-made plastic structures and stainless steel components.
• Work with machinery, hand tools and various assembly techniques.
• Carry out assembly and repair work on site.
• Handle plastic components up to 12 metres long.
• Work in a production environment, both independently and as part of a team.
• Carefully follow quality requirements and instructions.
• Travel to customer sites to carry out repairs, maintenance or installations.

Who are you?

• You have a technical background and knowledge of equipment or tools.
• You are motivated, eager to learn and willing to master new techniques.
• You have an eye for quality and a hands-on approach.
• Welding experience is an advantage.
• Physical work is not a problem for you.
• You have a good command of Dutch, French or English.

What you will do

Reporting to the Finance Manager, you join a small, collaborative team. The job is diverse and puts you in regular contact with other departments.

Day-to-day bookkeeping: booking incoming and outgoing payments and matching them against bank statements.

Billing and credit control: issuing customer invoices, monitoring open receivables and following up onoverdue payments.

Reporting: gathering figures for regular profitability and performance reporting.

Account reconciliations: carrying out monthly and year-end reconciliations of customer and supplier accounts.

Supplier invoice control: checking and approving incoming invoices from operational and general suppliers, in close contact with the operations team.
 
Your profile

• First experience in accounting (min. 2 years), either in a company or at an accounting office
• Fluent in Dutch and English
• Degree in accounting or a related field
• Knowledge of the logistics or transport sector is an asset, but not a requirement 
What we offer

• Attractive salary package (3500€-4000€ gross per month) with extralegal benefits such as meal vouchers, group insurance and more
• Full-time position with extra leave days on top of the legal holidays
• Possibility to work from home (1 day/week)
• Office within easy reach by public transport; available parking spot if needed
• The chance to be part of a growing organisation at an exciting stage of its development

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Accounts Team we are looking for a Customer Operations Manager (Jet Engines):The Customer Operations Manager leads the Shop Visit Managers and administrators within the Accounts team. This team consolidates the factory-wide operational status and plays a key role in ensuring transparent communication, coordination, and escalation management to support the efficient execution of engine shop visits.The Customer Operations Manager and his/her team are also responsible for the relationship, communication, and shop visit coordination with our external customers (airlines). He/she acts as the main point of contact for new customer onboarding, the management of complaints and disputes, and any other customer-related matters. He/she represents the customer and their contractual constraints internally within the shop.Your role:

• Lead and coordinate a team of Shop Visit Managers (engine owners), fostering performance, collaboration, and professional development.
• Oversee the work-in-progress status of all engine projects, ensuring adherence to commitments, schedules, and customer requirements.
• Act as the key interface between Operations, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, and the customer, ensuring clear communication and accurate reporting on project status and progress.
• Manage customer contractual constraints within the SAESB engine shop.
• Host customer visits, providing visibility on shop performance and ensuring a positive customer experience.*Lead strategic projects aimed at improving engine induction and delivery processes.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing operational performance and customer feedback, with the goal of enhancing volume output and efficiency.

Your profile:
 
 

• You hold a master's degree in engineering with a strong business affinity, or a degree in Business/Economics with a strong technical affinity or equivalent by experience. 

• You have strong business acumen and a results-driven mindset. 

• Experience in the aerospace or aeronautical industry is considered a strong asset. 

• You have at least 3 years of proven people management experience. 

• You are an excellent communicator and are fluent in English. Good knowledge of Dutch and French is a strong asset. 

• You possess strong interpersonal, stakeholder management, and representational skills. 

• You have a strong customer-oriented mindset.

Internal Sales Coördinator 

Are you an experienced people manager who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced operational environment? Do you combine strong leadership skills with a hands-on approach to order management, backlog management and customer service?

For an international and dynamic organization, I am looking for an Internal Sales Coördinator to lead a team of four employees.
In this role, you will be close to both the people and the operation. You will coach and develop your team, set priorities, monitor performance and ensure that customers and internal stakeholders receive clear and timely follow-up.
